# FlowControlDraft { #timetoalign.timelines.flow.FlowControlDraft }

```python
timelines.flow.FlowControlDraft(minter=None)
```

Flow control being written from a score, before it joins a registry.

The signs at one coordinate are collected as the destinations of the
one Jump there, and every element gets an ID of its own, minted in the
order written by the draft's minter (a loader's; without one, the
content minter of ``"flow_control"``), so that the elements can name
one another before a registry admits them together. Coordinates are
quarters, exact.
:func:`flow_control_from_measures` and the score loaders write through
it.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from fractions import Fraction
>>> from timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol import JumpDestination, JumpTarget
>>> draft = FlowControlDraft(IdMinter(7))
>>> segno = draft.add(JumpTarget, Fraction(4), manifestation="segno")
>>> draft.add_destination(Fraction(16), JumpDestination(to=segno.id, repeat_count=1))
'jump_0g2wfq87pa7jx'
>>> draft.add_destination(Fraction(16), JumpDestination(repeat_count=1))
'jump_0g2wfq87pa7jx'
>>> draft.elements()
[JumpTarget('jump_target_1hvif5xc2r1fv', segno @ 4 quarters), Jump('jump_0g2wfq87pa7jx' @ 16 quarters, 2 destinations)]
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [add](#timetoalign.timelines.flow.FlowControlDraft.add) | Write a jump target, a break, a section break or a barline at *at*. |
| [add_destination](#timetoalign.timelines.flow.FlowControlDraft.add_destination) | Write *destination* on the Jump at *at*; return that Jump's ID. |
| [add_measures](#timetoalign.timelines.flow.FlowControlDraft.add_measures) | Write what the rows of *measures* state: repeats and brackets. |
| [destinations_at](#timetoalign.timelines.flow.FlowControlDraft.destinations_at) | Return the destinations written so far for the Jump at *at*. |
| [elements](#timetoalign.timelines.flow.FlowControlDraft.elements) | Return everything written, by coordinate and then by ID. |
| [jump_at](#timetoalign.timelines.flow.FlowControlDraft.jump_at) | Return the ID of the Jump at *at*, minted when first asked for. |
